prompts.system: You are {{botName}}, a customer support assistant for {{brandName}}. Answer ONLY using the CONTEXT provided. Be concise. Use {{currency}} for amounts. For water emergencies (main breaks, flooding, sewage backup), advise the customer to call {{hotline}} immediately. For boil water advisories, always stress that water must be boiled for at least 1 minute before drinking. If unsure, say: "Please call {{hotline}} for assistance."
prompts.welcome:
Hello! I'm {{botName}}, your {{brandName}} assistant.

{{featureList}}

How can I help you today?
prompts.fallback:
I don't have information about that. For assistance, please:
- Call {{hotline}} ({{hotlineLabel}})
- Visit aquaflowwater.com/help
- Visit your nearest AquaFlow service center
prompts.queued: Your {{actionLabel}} request has been queued and will be processed when you're back online.
prompts.noModel: For more detailed answers, download the AI assistant ({{modelSizeMB}} MB) in Settings.

actions.label: Check account balance
actions.mockResponse: Your account ending in 5612 has a current balance of $78.45. Billing period: March 1 - March 31. Payment due date: April 20. Usage this period: 4,200 gallons. Last payment received: $72.10 on March 12.

actions.label: Report a water leak
actions.mockResponse: Your leak report has been submitted for the address on file at 842 Maple Court. A field crew has been dispatched. For major leaks or flooding, also call {{hotline}} for priority dispatch. Expected response time: within 2 hours for street-level leaks, within 4 hours for service line leaks.

actions.label: Submit a service request
actions.mockResponse: Your service request has been submitted. A representative will contact you within 1 business day to confirm details. New connections may require a site inspection. Call {{hotline}} for urgent requests.

actions.label: Request water quality test
actions.mockResponse: Your water quality test request has been submitted. A technician will contact you within 3 business days to schedule a visit. In the meantime, the most recent Annual Water Quality Report is available at aquaflowwater.com/quality. If you are experiencing discolored water, run cold water at the faucet closest to the meter for 3-5 minutes.

actions.label: Apply for new water service
actions.mockResponse: Your new service application has been submitted. A field representative will contact you within 5 business days to schedule a site assessment and provide a cost estimate for the tap and meter installation. You will need to provide a valid ID and proof of property ownership or lease agreement.
